name: superset
description: 即時儀表板:偵測 VSCode 終端機事件(開關、切換、命令執行、輸出),彙整成結構化檢視;並提供 Markdown `tree` 區塊語法高亮與預覽渲染。

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm ci && tsc && npm run build:vsix && bash scripts/verify-vsix.sh

superset.todo.maxDepth.description: Recursion depth for the workspace TODO scan used by the SuperSet TODO panel. Scans README.todo files from the open workspace root down to this many subdirectory levels (1–10). Default 5.

superset.editorLayout.maxRatio.description: Share of a direction the active editor group takes where the layout mode asks for 'Max' (0.5–0.9). Applied per direction, so 'Max horizontal, even vertical' widens the active column without shortening the rows inside it. Lowered automatically when a level has too many groups to give every sibling a visible share, and VS Code enforces a minimum group size on top of that, so this is a hint rather than a guarantee. Default 0.8.

superset.editorLayout.defaultShape.description: Grid shape used by 'Reset Editor Grid Shape'. 'flat' puts every editor group on the major axis; 'balanced' arranges them into a near-square grid. Only these two commands reshape the grid — the four layout modes always preserve the existing shape.

superset.editorLayout.followActiveGroup.description: In the 'Max' layout modes, re-apply the layout when the active editor group changes so the focused group is the enlarged one. The 'Even' modes never re-apply, leaving dividers you dragged by hand alone.

superset.editorLayout.restoreOnActivate.description: Apply the workspace's last chosen layout mode on startup. Restoring only rewrites orientation and sizes, never the grid shape.

superset.sessions.dataDir.description: Override the agent-session store root. Empty uses the sessiond default, ~/.config/superset/data/sessions. Intended for development against a scratch store.

superset.terminals.legacyOutputWatcher.description: Re-enable the legacy byte-reading activity watcher, which drains every shell execution's output stream through the extension host. Off by default: activity is detected by shell-integration start/end events plus process-tree polling, neither of which moves terminal output through the extension host. Only turn this on to compare against the old behaviour.

superset.cliLauncher.roots.markdownDescription: 要掃描的根目錄。CLI 面板從其下`兩層`候選中預設只顯示 Git repositories;第一層非 repository 若含第二層 repository,會保留為 category container。root 本身不出現,以 `.` 開頭的目錄與 `node_modules` 略過。設成 `[]` 即關閉掃描,只顯示 `#superset.cliLauncher.entries#` 的 literal paths;Regex entries 因沒有 scan candidates 而不會產生路徑。

path.description: 絕對路徑,或以 ~ 開頭的家目錄相對路徑。

label.description: 顯示名稱,省略時取路徑 basename。

regex.description: JavaScript Regex source;從 roots 的兩層 scan candidates 動態選取符合的路徑。

flags.description: 選用的 JavaScript Regex flags,例如 i。

superset.cliLauncher.entries.markdownDescription: 排在預設 Git repository 結果之前的 explicit paths,也可明確加入 non-repository。literal 字串簡寫等同 `{ "path": "..." }`;`{ "regex": "...", "flags": "i" }` 會從 `#superset.cliLauncher.roots#` 的兩層 scan candidates 動態選取。Regex 比對 absolute 與 `~/...` path,`hidden` 可排除 Dynamic Entry;格式錯誤的項目直接忽略。

superset.cliLauncher.focused.markdownDescription: Focus list 的 exact paths。可由 `Repo Path` context menu 加入或移除;不支援 Regex,也不改變 Git-only discovery。

superset.cliLauncher.focusedOnly.markdownDescription: 只顯示 Focus list 內的 exact paths,並保留抵達 focused child 所需的 ancestor category。Tree、Quick Pick 與 Copy All Paths 共用此 projection。

regex.description: JavaScript Regex source;符合的 path 與其 descendants 會隱藏。

flags.description: 選用的 JavaScript Regex flags,例如 i。

superset.cliLauncher.hidden.markdownDescription: 從面板排除的 scan paths。literal path 或 `{ "regex": "...", "flags": "i" }` 命中的路徑連同 descendants 都不再列出;Regex 比對 absolute 與 `~/...` path。資料夾本身不受影響,`CLI: Restore Hidden Paths` 可還原;literal Pinned Path 請直接從 `#superset.cliLauncher.entries#` 移除。

superset.cliLauncher.agentCommands.markdownDescription: 三顆 agent 按鈕送進 terminal 的命令,可含旗標(例如 `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`)。非字串或空白值 fallback 回同名 CLI。
